overview.title:
Every trip,
in view.
overview.intro: Bring your buses, routes and daily trips together in one calm workspace.
overview.sectionIntro: The essentials for keeping people moving.
overview.busesBody: Keep bus details and passenger capacity organized in one place.
overview.routesBody: Build clear routes and schedules for the trips ahead.
overview.tripsBody: Share a bus’s location and help passengers plan their arrival.
overview.footer: Designed for administrators, drivers and passengers.

preferences.title: Workspace preferences
preferences.intro: Choose your appearance and language. The language selector is available at the top of any page.
preferences.languageBody: English, German and Arabic are available. Arabic also changes the layout to read from right to left.
preferences.previewBody: Dates and numbers follow your selected language. These are example values.

notFound.title: Let’s get you back on route.

notices.expired: Your session has ended. Log in again to continue.

notices.loginRequired: Log in to open that page.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Choose a light or dark appearance, or follow your device setting.
appearance.saved: Your choice is saved on this browser and also applies to login and registration.

buses.intro: Manage bus registrations, capacity and availability.
buses.registrationHint: Up to 32 characters; no surrounding spaces.
buses.activeHint: Inactive buses remain in the system. You can reactivate them later.
buses.empty: No buses match your search or filters.
buses.tableHint: Select a column heading to change sorting.

dialog.description: Enter the bus details. Registration number and capacity are required.
dialog.deleteWarning: Permanently delete this bus? You can deactivate it instead by editing its active status.
dialog.reloadWarning: Reloading replaces your unsaved form values. Review the latest details before saving again.

validation.FORMAT: Remove surrounding spaces and control characters.
validation.POSITIVE: Enter a capacity of at least 1.
validation.MAX_VALUE: Enter a number no greater than 2,147,483,647.

errors.UNAVAILABLE: We could not confirm the result. Close this dialog if open and refresh the list before trying again.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: The request was not accepted. Check the details and refresh the list.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some details are invalid. Check the registration number and capacity.
errors.AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED: Your session has ended. Log in again to continue.
errors.ACCESS_DENIED: This request was not authorized. Close the dialog and refresh the page to check your session.
errors.BUS_NOT_FOUND: This bus no longer exists. Close the dialog and refresh the list.
errors.BUS_REGISTRATION_CONFLICT: That registration number is already in use. Choose another.
errors.BUS_VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone changed this bus. Reload the latest details and review them before trying again.
errors.BUS_IN_USE: This bus is referenced elsewhere and cannot be deleted. Deactivate it instead.
